generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Tender Conditions(No1)Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable(No2) Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government Government of India Union Territory(No.3) It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of eProcurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission (No4) The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders the department shall not be responsible for non accessibility of eProcurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

Tender Conditions - (No5)EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection (No.6) Conditional tender will not be considered (No.7) Sub-Leasing/G.P.A of Work is prohibited (No.8) Tender Processing Fee is not refundable (No9) Contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution (No 10) The rates quoted shall be inclusive of providing barricading fittings of danger lights, Jungle clearance near work spot / watchman etc., complete and maintained till completion of work and removing on completion as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of work. Rates quoted should include clearance of site prior to commencement of work and its closure in all respects and holds good for all works under all conditions of site, moisture and weather.

Tender Conditions - (No.11) Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost. All quantity and gradation of metal collected for the works should be got approved by the competent authority before use (No.12) 1% of the tender amount will be deducted from the work bill towards Construction Workers Welfare cess besides the other statutory deductions. (No13) Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per the rates prevailing at the time of execution of the work (No 14) Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act (No 15) Even though tenderers meet the all the criteria they are subject to be disqualified if they have. - made misleading or false representations in forms, statement and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc., and/or Participated in the previous tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.

Tender Conditions - (No.16) The Defects liability period is 1 year. The contractor has the liability of rectifying the defects for a period of 1 Year from the date of completion of the work at his cost. (No.17) All the Scaned documents uploaded should be Original/attested by the Notary. (No18) Drawings uploaded are for Tender Purpose Only. (No 19) The employer reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tender without assigning any reason (No 20) The rates quoted shall be for finished items of work inclusive of all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, all incidental charges and all taxes, local or general royalty etc., complete payable to the Government or local bodies in the region (No.21) The bidder should quote the rates excluding GST

Tender Conditions - (No.21) The bidder should quote the rates excluding GST (No.22) 3.2 (a) Qualification To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2015-16-2019-20) Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turn over of Rs.16.05 Lakhs (usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract for works costing up to 100 Lakhs). 3.2 (b) satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one work such as maintenance/improvements/cost of tanks for RS 8.025 LAKHS for all works costing upto and Rs 100 Lakhs. 3.2 ( (e) The contractor quote the rate excluding GST (No 23) The laborers deployed shall mandatorily wear the face mask, and gloves and take all safety measures to protect laborers and staff from COVID-19 (No 24) MDDP is must for sand and aggregate and other required material

Tender Conditions-(No.25) If the bidder quotes below amount put to tender, then the difference amount FD should be up loaded and same should be produced at the time of verification.(No 26) Contractor should up load valid License (No 27) Contractor should up load valid GST Copy. (No 28) Contractor should up load 5 years Financial Turnover Certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant along with UDIN Number.(No 29) Contractor should up load valid Similar Nature of work done Certificate duly signed by Executive Engineer. (No 30) Contractor should up load valid EPF and ESI Registration Certificate and latest payment Chellan or Receips. (No 31) Contractor should up load difference amount FDR for below quoted rates. (No 32) The contractor should not quote the labour rates not less than the SR Rates, if the quote labour rates below the SR Rate, the bid will be rejected.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: ANNUAL MAINTENANCE OF ANNEMADUVINAKERE TANK IN CHAMARAJANAGARA TALUK CHAMARAJANGARA DISTRICT

itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing land including uprooting rank vegetable grass,bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees upto 300mm girth by manual means,in areas of light jungle, removal of stumps, disposal of unserviceable materials, stacking of serviceable materials from road boundary etc.including cost of labour charges, all lead and lifts, etc. complete as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all other ancillary operations complete.  As directed by the Engineer in charge.

Excavation and removal of silt and silt mixed with sand from canal bed by manual means including disposing off the same in spoil bank or on the canal embankment in layers as directed with all other ancillary operations complete in dry condition as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Removing and resetting disturbed dry rubble / size stone pitching 250 to 450 mm thick including packing and wedging with stone chips, finishing surface with all other ancillary operations complete. as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Providing casing embankment for breached / damaged portion of canal using approved pervious /semi-pervious soil in layers of 100 to 150 mm ( before compaction ) including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all operations such as collection of soil, spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting out, breaking clods, sectioning sides / edges, watering, compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent or as stipulated using power roller or  pneumatic /vibrating plate compactors with all other ancillary operations complete from dump areas as directed by the Engineer in charge.
